expiring.runResult: Alerts: {alerts}, e-mails queued: {emails}, assets without a contact to notify: {noRecipients}
expiring.runDisabled: Expiry alerts are switched off in the Alerts tab.
expiring.hint: Includes dates that expired in the last year.

obsolescence.hint: Based on the vendor end-of-support date (or end of life) matched by manufacturer and model. Assets without a match are counted as no vendor data.
obsolescence.byYear: Assets reaching end of support, by year
obsolescence.empty: No assets match the vendor lifecycle table yet. Add or import entries in the Vendor end of life tab.

vendor.hint: Manufacturer end-of-sale, end-of-support and end-of-life dates. A model can use * and ? as wildcards (for example S7-12*). The most specific entry wins.
vendor.dateRequired: At least one date is required.

cost.hint: Purchase cost plus maintenance, upgrade and licence costs recorded on assets. Currencies are never converted into each other.
cost.empty: No costs recorded yet. Add a purchase cost on an asset or record costs on the asset page.

assetCost.title: Cost of ownership
assetCost.required: Amount, currency and date are required.

settings.hint: Alerts go to the owners and points of contact of an asset (matched to users by e-mail) once for each lead time, and once more when the date has passed. The check runs every day.
settings.leadDays: Lead times (days before expiry, separated by commas)
settings.invalid: Enter whole numbers of days, for example 90, 30, 7.
